about.title: About Standard Constructors
text: Standard Constructors, Inc is a fourth-generation family construction company established in 1939 with offices in Texas and Louisiana. We are a leading heavy civil industrial contractor, offering innovative, cost-efficient and turnkey solutions for a diverse group of petrochemical, refining, and heavy commercial clients along the Gulf Coast and throughout the United States.

Our experienced, professional team can plan, manage and execute a magnitude of projects ranging from small capital & maintenance projects to large capital mega projects – with highly skilled craftsmen, superior project management, quality control, cost efficiency, and an unmatched Diamond level safety program.
Standard Constructors, based in Houston, has four convenient regional offices to serve you along the Gulf Coast. Contact us today and we’ll be happy to serve you.
